guide.tagline: Record your screen, or speed up a long session into a short time-lapse.
guide.summary: Record a display or chosen windows at normal speed, or as a time-lapse that captures a frame every few seconds. Recording keeps running if you leave the page. Export a video when you are done. Everything stays on your Mac.

steps.title: Choose what to record
steps.detail: Pick a display or specific windows. macOS asks for Screen Recording access the first time.

steps.title: Press Record
steps.detail: Add audio or the cursor under Audio & options, then stop whenever you are done.

steps.title: Export a video
steps.detail: Select a recording, choose a quality and save it as a video file.
